in_marathi.name: Anupriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu (meaning 'near') + Priya (meaning 'love, delight'), thus, Anupriya means 'one who is near and dear, loveable, delightful'. This name is derived from the ancient Indian culture and is popular in Hindu communities.
